new: Inception is a free program that guides AI startups through the NVIDIA platform and ecosystem. Inception is free. The program doesn’t have application fees, membership fees, or equity requirements. You can apply to the NVIDIA Inception program regardless of your company’s current funding stage. There are no application fees, deadlines, or cohorts. Inception members have access to the latest developer tools and training, preferred pricing on NVIDIA hardware and software, exclusive offers from partners, and exposure to a global ecosystem of investors. Access free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners for more flexible, scalable development and deployment. Members must maintain a working website, be officially incorporated, be less than 10 years old, have a clear use case for NVIDIA technology, and be actively operated by at least one founder. Solo founders with no other employees may also apply.
